title: High Risk of Political Bias in Black Box Emotion Inference Models

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing and comparing predicted valence scores from a sentiment analysis model for 24 Polish politicians' names, both in isolation and embedded within neutral and politically charged sentences, and regressing these scores against their political party affiliations.
Included as a confounding variable in regression models to assess whether the sentiment model's predicted valence scores differed systematically based on the gender of the politicians.
